fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Spare-Limb Cudgel
fusions.desc: Costs 6% of your maximum health. Swings your severed tail as a club across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Frill and Chest
fusions.desc: A threat display that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Thrash
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
